title: MASTER TECHNICAL AND MANAGED SERVICES AGREEMENT

clauses.title: 1. MANAGED CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE SCOPE
clauses.text: 1. MANAGED CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE SCOPE. Service Provider delivers 24x7 monitoring, patch management, and cloud architecture optimization under Statements of Work.

clauses.title: 2. SLA UPTIME COMMITMENT AND CREDITS
clauses.text: 2. SLA UPTIME COMMITMENT AND CREDITS. Service Provider guarantees 99.95% cloud availability. If uptime falls below 99.0%, Client receives a 20% billing credit.

clauses.title: 3. MUTUAL CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS
clauses.text: 3. MUTUAL CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Each party protects confidential information with reasonable care, surviving for three (3) years following agreement termination.

clauses.title: 4. MUTUAL DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND ARBITRATION
clauses.text: 4. MUTUAL DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND ARBITRATION. Any controversy shall be submitted to binding arbitration in San Francisco, California under AAA commercial arbitration rules.
